claims: The official OpenTelemetry OTLP HTTP exporter sends an ordinary root and GenAI child into the real Chorus receiver
The public HttpSidecarWriter sends trace-linked retained content and feedback through the real generic sidecar endpoint
Chorus displays trace latency, token usage, currency-aware known cost, pricing coverage, feedback, and model identity
Root-row promotion selects the GenAI child and persists an evaluation case linked to the real trace, root, and child span IDs
With CHORUS_API_TOKEN configured, unauthenticated quality API and sidecar requests return 401 while authenticated OTLP, sidecar, and read requests succeed
demoCommands: Official OpenTelemetry SDK plus OTLPSpanExporter to http://127.0.0.1:8114/v1/traces, HttpSidecarWriter to http://127.0.0.1:8114, then browser Promote
Authenticated OTLPSpanExporter and HttpSidecarWriter to port 8115, followed by unauthenticated 401 and authenticated 200 API probes
isolation: Dedicated /tmp corpora, synthetic evidence-agent data, localhost only, no production services or message delivery
limitations: Local receiver path only; no production deployment or external collector
